subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (v) Digital Bangladesh is a new but ambitious concept in the country. (b) + (iii) Digital Bangladesh is a vision of bringing about a digital change in every sector. (c) + (i) It is a process of digitalizing everything in our national life. (d) + (iv) Our life-style, daily activities, business transaction, communications, entertainment, studies, consultations, etc. would be made on line. (e) + (ii) Economically rich and industrially developed countries are fully depended on digitalization process. First Paper  Solutions
